session_summary: Created ModelReconciliation notebook comparing published ADP1 model vs ModelSEED model with pFBA, FVA at 50% optimum in pyruvate media, and comprehensive comparison dataframe.

project.name: ADP1NotebookUtils
project.purpose: Compare published and ModelSEED metabolic models of ADP1 in shared namespace

notebook_cells.purpose: Title and overview of reconciliation workflow
Load published model from JSON and ModelSEED model from KBase, save model info
Description of Cell 2: Run pFBA and FVA
Run pFBA and FVA at 50% optimum on both models in pyruvate media
Description of Cell 3: Build comparison dataframe
Build comprehensive comparison dataframe with flux, FVA class, membership, genes, directionality, equation, stoichiometry differences

utility_functions.name: classify_fva_flux
utility_functions.purpose: Classify reaction FVA results into categories (blocked, essential_fwd, essential_rev, variable, optionally_active, etc.)

utility_functions.name: standardize_exchange_id
utility_functions.purpose: Standardize exchange reaction IDs to EX_cpd<ID> format across models

utility_functions.name: get_exchange_map
utility_functions.purpose: Build map from standardized exchange ID to original reaction ID

utility_functions.name: compare_reaction_stoichiometry
utility_functions.purpose: Compare stoichiometry and compartment between two reactions

utility_functions.name: get_reaction_directionality
utility_functions.purpose: Return directionality string (forward/reverse/reversible) for a reaction

utility_functions.name: build_gene_reaction_map
utility_functions.purpose: Build gene-to-reaction-list map, filtering mRNA_ genes

created.purpose: Notebook comparing published vs ModelSEED ADP1 models

modified.changes: Added 6 utility methods: classify_fva_flux, standardize_exchange_id, get_exchange_map, compare_reaction_stoichiometry, get_reaction_directionality, build_gene_reaction_map

comments: Published model uses GROWTH_DASH_RXN as biomass; ModelSEED uses bio1
Published model exchanges use EXF_DASH_*_LBRACKET_Extraorganism_RBRACKET_ format; ModelSEED uses EX_cpd*_e0
Exchange IDs are standardized to EX_cpd<ID> format for consistent comparison
FVA runs at 50% optimum as requested
Cell 2 reloads models fresh (no cached model objects) to ensure media/objective are cleanly set
Cell 3 loads only cached flux/FVA results but reloads models for structure comparison
